Have any of you tried rolling for where the PC is hit/when a PC hits? Mainly as a way to add flavor or break up an endless succession of "My fighter swings a sword into the guard's head".

  • 01-01 - Head
  • 02-06 - Chest
  • 07-10 - Left Arm
  • 11-14 - Right Arm
  • 15-17 - Left Leg
  • 18-20 - Right Leg
Rolling for where a strike hits.

What I do is define all attacks within 50% of hitting, or just within 5 of the required roll (so rolling between 10-15 against 10 defense, assuming 10 hits) default to a boring torso hit. Anything higher than that is up to the player in RP and provides a bonus to the strike in the form of some kind of debuff. Works well, since it doesn't require a second roll to slow things down.

Although yours provides a lot more RP.
